validation_protocol.initialization: query the selected reconstructed segment at initialization_utc
validation_protocol.scoring: query that same selected segment at each predeclared checkpoint
validation_protocol.model_parameters: preserve each chapter's existing G multiplied by rounded body masses

checkpoint_contract.anchor_definition: Initialization audit only. Position and velocity error are identically zero by construction and are not a Chapter 1/2 accuracy score.
checkpoint_contract.primary_definition: A primary score must lie in a documented maneuver-free pre-encounter window. Initialization is an anchor, not a headline score. Encounter and post-maneuver points remain useful diagnostics but are not headline Chapter 1/2 accuracy claims.
checkpoint_contract.diagnostic_definition: A diagnostic score is retained for visibility but overlaps a maneuver phase, an undocumented correction boundary, or an encounter where the simplified force model is not a like-for-like replay.
checkpoint_contract.excluded_definition: An excluded score is not used for Chapter 1/2 accuracy claims because a documented maneuver or close-encounter event is known to invalidate an uncontrolled comparison.

maneuver_evidence.v1_jupiter: NASA cruise material identifies a Jan 29 correction with additional Feb 20 and Mar 16 correction activity, but does not provide a complete inertial delta-v vector for replay.
maneuver_evidence.v2_jupiter: JPL 83-53 places TCM-3/B-3 and TCM-4/B-4 inside the May 29-Jun 27 and Jun 27-Jul 7 far-encounter phases, with TCM-5/B-5 post-encounter; complete inertial vectors are not published in the source.
maneuver_evidence.v1_saturn: A-8 occurred Oct 10-11 1980 (1.778 m/s, 806 s, 90 deg roll plus 136.7 deg yaw); A-9 occurred Nov 6 1980. The available report does not provide a complete replay vector for both events.
maneuver_evidence.v2_saturn: B-7 occurred Feb 26 1981 (0.574 m/s, 215 s); B-8 occurred Jul 19 with roll/yaw targeting; B-9 occurred Aug 18 (1.018 m/s, 380 s). Complete inertial replay vectors are not available in the cited source.

kernel_precedence: SPICE gives the last-loaded competing SPK segment the highest priority. The encounter kernel therefore wins for the selected spacecraft, and DE440 wins for planetary states.

cruise_reference.available_reference: the spacecraft segments in the merged Voyager supertrajectory kernels
cruise_reference.status: educational/mission-design reference; not established here as a navigation-grade reconstructed orbit
cruise_reference.supported_claim: agreement with the published merged supertrajectory
cruise_reference.unsupported_claim: absolute navigation accuracy over the cruise interval
cruise_reference.research_result: No separate public tracking-fit state-vector SPK for this complete interval was identified in the NAIF Voyager archive or the NASA technical material surveyed. Navigation reports describe orbit determination and maneuvers but do not publish a machine-readable reconstructed trajectory covering the interval.
